summary: Real #634 budget rails: durable .agentic/budget/spend.json for daily/cycle/USD spend across process restarts; cost_ceiling_usd hard pause (unless warn); status remaining_usd from ceiling; gitignore ephemeral spend file.
migration_impact: New local file .agentic/budget/spend.json (gitignored). AutonomyEngine.enforce_budget persists spend and enforces cost_ceiling_usd. No .plate schema change (uses existing token_budget + cost_ceiling_usd).
migration_guidance: 3. Long --loop / multi-process hosts now share durable spend counters for the UTC day.
4. On PAUSE from budget or ceiling, inspect plate_autonomy_status / cost dashboard before raising caps.
agent_notes: risk_tolerance=off still skips enforcement (manual mode). Prefer pause for production ceilings. Do not delete spend.json mid-day to bypass limits. Pairs with #653 dashboard feed items.
